race.comment: BOOGIE ON BY (5) is hard to look past after rattling home into the placings at Townsville on debut. If she can settle in the same postcode this time and let down with the same turn of foot, good luck stopping her. ROWEINER'S MAGIC (1) has the direct form edge on her from the same race, having run second as a well-supported favourite, beaten a length after a much more economical run. Low draw gives him a tidy platform to be right there again. SCOTTISH BARBER (3) brings a different profile as a first starter from the Kris Hansen yard. Caught the eye with a dominant trial win here in readiness over the 1000m, and from the inside gate she should get every chance to hit the ground running. While DREAM CRUSHER (6), on the other hand, has the wide barrier to overcome, she is another that has shown encouraging signs in her lead-up work. Will pay to see what the market thinks.
